scope: Human-controlled archival audit of existing public research documents only; no private conversations, autonomous execution, replication or model activation.
method: Two GitHub reads (main and audit branch); exact UTF-8 returned text equality and SHA-256. SHA-256 implementation checked against empty and abc known vectors. Mutation check appends X. These checks establish consistency of returned text, not authenticity of authorship or independent storage availability.
rights: Existing author rights unchanged. No new licence or permission to redistribute granted.
limitations: No IPFS upload or pinning performed.
No digital signature or timestamp authority used.
